scoring.note: Score authority v2 (Console 2.0). Campaign measures quality of completion (bounded); Arcade measures survival + mastery (endless, true score never clamped).

lifecycle.spawn: Allocate actor ID only when a spawn commits. Campaign normal levels open with their authored openingPopulation as a staggered formation: each member starts the wave-intro shimmer openingStaggerTicks after the one before, outside the replacement cadence and spacing rules. The cumulative roster ceiling is openingPopulation plus the completed share (beats 1..5 of 5) of the remaining roster; cadence, mounted occupancy and shimmer still apply after the formation. Select an existing authored anchor near the active ring region; the formation takes one distinct anchor per member. Arcade retains literal modulo anchors; bosses retain authored transition spawns. Ghost assignments keep authored roster order.
transitions: rider reaches safe ground after 30 ticks
wave authorization revoked only after campaign transition
lifecycle.waveClear: authorizedActorIds is empty after deferred removals and spawnCursor equals the roster total; no lifecycle object may return.

input.coordinateRule: Map PointerEvent client coordinates through canvas.getBoundingClientRect into 256x384 logical integers using floor; reject outside rectangle.

rules.cleanup: Clear all held states and queued edges on blur, hidden, pause entry, cinema entry, death, gamepad disconnect, pointercancel, and lostpointercapture
rules.flapBuffer: During PLAY, a FLAP edge may wait up to 8 ticks for cooldown availability; then it expires instead of firing late.
rules.flapQueue: FIFO; cap 4; drop newest edge on overflow; consume at most one edge per simulation tick
rules.freshPress: After cleanup, all controls require a new down edge
rules.leftAndRight: CHORD: strong straight-up impulse and lateral cancellation
rules.pointerOwnership: Each pointer owns one wing until release; a predominantly downward slide triggers DART once.
rules.wingTap: Touch-down is the flap edge; never wait for release.

campaign_levels.storyLine: You do not inherit this sky.
Some things survived because we forgot.
Finish it - or watch everything die apart.

campaign.schema.hashRule: SHA-256 canonical JSON before contentHash is added

rules.continue: restores an exact active run; GAMEOVER is terminal for the score run (no continue)
rules.coupling: STAGE: course and wave advance together
rules.courseAdvance: ORDERED_RING_6 of the stage layout; the GREEN ring ends the stage
rules.carryOver: unresolved mounted/spawning/remounting rivals and unspawned roster entries carry into the next stage, at most scoring.carry.cap; eggs and riders are forfeited
rules.altitudeGate: a ring opens only when combat keeps pace: order <= min(rings, floor(resolved*6/total)) + 1
rules.waveAdvance: with the stage (hostile clear alone does not advance)
rules.winner: NONE; game ends only when lives reach zero

CRAWL: THE BUILT-IN REFERENCE ROM COMES ONLINE.
THE FINAL GATE RETURNS TO A CLEAN CONSOLE.

save_protocol.canonical: Recursive keys sorted by Unicode code point; arrays retain order; strings JSON escaped; integers decimal without plus sign or leading zero; booleans/null lowercase; no floats; UTF-8; no trailing newline.
save_protocol.checksum: Set checksum to 64 ASCII zero characters, canonicalize the whole record, then SHA-256 and replace checksum with lowercase hex.

interruptions.beforeunload: no new authoritative mutation; best-effort only
interruptions.failure: preserve previous active slot and show SAVE NOT UPDATED on resume

save_protocol.migration: No pre-clean-room namespace is accepted. Unknown schema or buildId is rejected. A future schema must add an explicit pure migration and fixture before the version number changes.
restore: otherwise choose valid slot with greatest payload.sim.tick; tie chooses A
if neither is valid show NEW GAME and RESET DATA
